property_summary: For any admissible call, C's balance only ever decreases (a payout occurs) when block.number % 15 == 0; the mutant pays out on the complement blocks, so its balance decreases on non-multiples of 15, breaking the rule.
change_summary: Replace the modulo condition `block.number % 15 == 0` with `block.number % 15 != 0`, inverting when payouts occur.
